purpose: Machine-readable intake queue for roadmap/review artifacts awaiting reviewer-role rebuttal or already carrying a filed rebuttal.
defaultResolutionRule: When an operator asks to check or review a roadmap without giving a path, resolve this queue and load the highest-priority item with status READY_FOR_REBUTTAL.

items.notes: Second reviewer-role rebuttal required before any accepted candidate proceeds to GC-018 or implementation.
C1 blocking; A1/E1/G1 non-blocking; D1/H1 require gate update.
Original CDH roadmap has blocking findings; later delta closures should be cited instead of treating this as executable.
